dfl.title: An integrated dataset of spatiotemporal and event data in elite soccer
dfl.scope: All 21 files: match information, events and positions for seven matches.

metrica.scope: All files under data/, documentation/, plus README and license. External optional full body-pose downloads linked by SkillCorner are not part of these match-tracking files.

skillcorner.scope: All files under data/, documentation/, plus README and license. External optional full body-pose downloads linked by SkillCorner are not part of these match-tracking files.

storage: Large text files are losslessly gzip compressed during transfer; no full uncompressed copy is stored.
